name: pam_tally2
detailed_description: Legacy account lockout module for Debian/Ubuntu systems that maintains login failure counters. Tracks failed authentication attempts and locks accounts temporarily after exceeding the configured threshold. Gradually being replaced by pam_faillock on modern systems.

parameters.lock_time: Time to keep user locked out (seconds)

notes:
Debian account lockout; deprecated in favor of pam_faillock on some systems
